name: adaptive-eval-review-fixes
title: fix(eval): 独立审查修复——真实 schema 脱敏、预算不可绕过、空语料必红、版本与状态校验（票 5cj）
description: 按独立审查（2 高危 + 多个中危）修复 P3 评测代码：1) 脱敏覆盖真实 schema 身份字段（workflow_thread_id/reviewer/nickname/author/post_id/note_id）、URL/link 键清空、路径类键与任意位置绝对路径规范化、messages 永远丢弃并移除损坏的 --include-messages；2) JudgeBudget 上限不可绕过（>199 ValueError），judge_content 的 budget 改为必填；3) 门禁：空语料红、redaction_version 不符红、未列出 fixture 文件红、required benchmark 必须 PASS 且未知状态红、policy 类型检查、决策相同的 variant 红、mode 由 --fail-on-red 决定；4) 抽取器 sqlite 只读打开+不存在报错、跳过 subgraph checkpoint_ns、phase 过滤不再放行空 phase；5) plan_l3 预算改为总量口径（calls_per_sample 必填）；6) 文档与 runbook 同步真实行为。测试 14+23+12+13+ci_local 全绿。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-11-02. Fixes every finding from the independent read-only review (2 high, 9 medium, 3 low) rather than documenting around them. HIGH 1 (data leak): the identifier table was an eight-name exact denylist while the real state carries PublishResult.workflow_thread_id, BloggerProfile.nickname/avatar_url, CompetitorPost.author, ShootingPlan.creator_nickname/profile_link, HumanFeedback.reviewer and post/note ids — all were copied verbatim. The table now covers those real fields (thread/user/creator/post pseudonyms), *_url/*_link keys are blanked (a URL that still resolves is a leak even with a fake host), path-shaped keys are normalised to image/NN.ext, and any string that matches an absolute path (drive letter or /Users,/home,/tmp,/var,/opt,/root,/mnt) is blanked and counted; a regression test seeds the real schema fields and asserts no plaintext reaches the written fixture. HIGH 2 (budget bypass): JudgeBudget now refuses max_calls > 199 outright and judge_content's budget argument is required, so the 'optimisation point' cannot be skipped by looping N times with an implicit per-call budget; provider-internal retries are documented as outside the count. MEDIUM fixes: empty corpus (0 fixtures) is red instead of PASS; a corpus whose manifest redaction_version differs from the current one is red (SCHEMA/REDACTION/EXTRACTOR all bumped to 2 so the leaky extractor's output cannot stay green); unlisted fixture-*.json files are red; F1/F2/F4 must report PASS (SKIP/ERROR previously passed) and unknown statuses are red; check_policy validates types (non-blank string model, None-or-non-negative-int budget, task->list[str] escalation, tool_limits shape); a --variant whose diff is empty is red (a factory that quietly returns the default is a mis-wire, not a pass); mode is derived from --fail-on-red (report/block) instead of whether a variant was passed; the broken --include-messages switch is removed and messages are always dropped (on real checkpoints LangChain BaseMessage made redaction raise and silently produced zero fixtures); the sqlite extractor checks is_file() and opens mode=ro so a typo cannot create an empty database and call it a corpus, and catches sqlite3.OperationalError; non-empty checkpoint_ns rows are skipped and counted as subgraph_checkpoint; --phases no longer lets phase-less fixtures through. LOW: plan_l3 now requires --calls-per-sample and checks samples*(1+calls_per_sample) <= 199, because the <200 approval is about total model calls, not judge verdicts. Docs list the real E3 scope (no L1/L2 replay or thresholds) and the corrected test counts and gate semantics; the runbook's plan command carries the new flag. Verification: test_eval_fixtures 14 passed, test_eval_gate 23, test_eval_judge 12, test_eval_plan_l3 13, test_ci_local updated to require --fail-on-red; tests/unit/scripts 172 passed; gate smoke run prints corpus SKIP/policy PASS/benchmarks PASS mode=report; full suite in the journal; ruff clean.
